title: clusterMap of tpg-patch
description: The clusterMap input of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-patch: registered clusters, their keys and their instances. Generated from workflows/params/cluster-map-keys.yaml by workflows/params/clustermap_schema.py; the validate step of the workflow is the authority (registered clusters, required values an input may supply, combinations of values).

operatorValuesPatchFilePath.description: An operator values file: a path of the submitting machine (its contents in patchFiles) or repo:helm_artifacts/operator/patches/<file>. tpg-patch: it becomes the current operator values patch file, applied on top of the operator overlay of tpg-day0 [List (one file path); optional (default: the input operatorValuesPatchFilePath)]

patchMode.description: apply or clear, for the operator file of this cluster and the default of its instances [Enum; optional (default: the input patchMode)]

backupCaBundleFile.description: The backup CA bundle of the cluster's instances with backupEnableSSL: a PEM file of the submitting machine (its contents in patchFiles) or repo:ca-bundles/<file>. Not together with backupCaBundleVaultSecret on this level; an instance key wins [List (one file path); optional (the instance key, else the cluster key, else the inputs)]

backupCaBundleVaultSecret.description: The backup CA bundle from Vault tpg/ca-bundles/<name> (key caBundle; tpg-aks-infra scripts/vault-secret.sh ca put). Not together with backupCaBundleFile on this level; an instance key wins [String (name); optional (the instance key, else the cluster key, else the inputs)]

clearKinds.description: patchMode=clear: the kinds whose current file is removed. operatorValues clears the operator file of the cluster; instance kinds are the default of its instances [List (kinds); optional (default: the input clearKinds)]

instances.description: The instances of the cluster (namespace: the key namespace of tpg-day0 and tpg-create-instance, default pg-<instance>)

postgresVersion.description: tpg-day0, tpg-create-instance and tpg-upgrade: the version to deploy or upgrade to. Guard in the other workflows: when set, an instance that runs another version is skipped (SKIPPED_VERSION_MISMATCH) and nothing is changed for it [String (version); guard (skip an instance that runs another version)]

backupCaBundleFile.description: The backup CA bundle of this instance (backupEnableSSL true): a PEM file of the submitting machine (its contents in patchFiles) or repo:ca-bundles/<file>. Wins over the cluster level and the inputs; not together with backupCaBundleVaultSecret [List (one file path); optional (the instance key, else the cluster key, else the inputs)]

backupCaBundleVaultSecret.description: The backup CA bundle of this instance from Vault tpg/ca-bundles/<name> (key caBundle). Wins over the cluster level and the inputs; not together with backupCaBundleFile [String (name); optional (the instance key, else the cluster key, else the inputs)]

postgresPatchFilePath.description: One or more files (a list) of Postgres, PostgresBackupLocation, PostgresBackupSchedule and PostgresFerretDocumentDB documents, one document per object: paths of the submitting machine (their contents in patchFiles) or repo:helm_artifacts/instance/tpg-instance/patches/<file>. Combined into one stored file helm_artifacts/instance/tpg-instance/patches/<instance>-postgres-<hash>.yaml; the objects a run does not send are carried over from the current file. Applied on top of the overlay of tpg-day0 and tpg-create-instance [List (file paths); optional (default: the input postgresPatchFilePath)]

postgresValuesPatchFilePath.description: A tpg-instance chart values file: a path of the submitting machine or repo:helm_artifacts/instance/tpg-instance/patches/<file>, stored as helm_artifacts/instance/tpg-instance/patches/<name>-<uid>.yaml. Renamed from valuesPatchFilePath in Round 15; applied on top of the overlay [List (one file path); optional (default: the input postgresValuesPatchFilePath)]

patchMode.description: apply or clear, for the patch files of this instance [Enum; optional (default: the input patchMode)]

clearKinds.description: patchMode=clear: the kinds whose current file or documents are removed: Postgres, PostgresBackupLocation, PostgresBackupSchedule, PostgresFerretDocumentDB, postgresValues, or all [List (kinds); optional (default: the input clearKinds)]
